title: Siege of Hikida Castle
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Hikida Castle", at revision 1382505228, opens: "The 1573 siege of Hikida Castle  was one of many battles the warlord Oda Nobunaga fought against the Azai and Asakura clans during Japan's Sengoku period. These two families were among the staunchest opponents of Nobunaga's attempts to seize land and power for himself." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11679996, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1573 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
